events.title: Diwali 2026 in Delhi
events.description: Diwali 2026 in Delhi is Sunday 8 November. Drik Panchang for Delhi NCT lists Lakshmi Puja in Pradosh from 5:54 pm to 7:50 pm. Dhanteras is Friday 6 November, Choti Diwali Saturday 7 November, Bhai Dooj Wednesday 11 November. The civic walk is Kartavya Path at India Gate after sunset. Markets: Chandni Chowk on Friday and Saturday (most shops shut Sunday), Dilli Haat INA on the usual DTTDC ticket. Neighbourhood mandirs and Bangla Sahib langar do the public-facing work. Crackers follow the DPCC notice for that week. There is no single ticketed Delhi Diwali gate.

events.title: Call for Applications: AIOE National Award for Outstanding Industrial Relations 2025-26
events.description: All India Organisation of Employers (AIOE) supported by FICCI has been conferring the National Awards for Outstanding Industrial Relations since 1983.This prestigious award recognizes organizations that have demonstrated innovative practices to foster harmonious industrial relations and a positive work environment. A distinguished jury comprising eminent professionals from diverse fields will evaluate the entries.The award will be presented during the 92nd AIOE Annual General Meeting & Annual Convention to be held on 11th December, 2026, which in the past has been inaugurated by the Hon’ble Minister for Labour & Employment, Government of India.Award Categories• Manufacturing (Large, Medium and Emerging / MSME)• Services(Large, Medium and Emerging / MSME) – sectors like IT-ITES, Construction, Ports, Real Estate, Finance , Infrastructure, Power, Healthcare, Hospitality, Education and any other• AI and Digital Transformation in IR (New)Selection Process1. At the first stage, participating establishments shortlisted by the associations will present at the regional level. Finalists will be selected in each category.2. These finalists will then compete at the national level in New Delhi for the final awards.The duly completed application, along with the requisite fee, should reach this office no later than 13th November, 2026. Applications should clearly mention the title and the category:• Application for AIOE National Award for Outstanding Industrial Relations 2025-26 (category)• Application should be submitted in the report format.Applications may be sent to:Parisha SinghJoint DirectorAll India Organisation of EmployersFederation House, Tansen Marg,New Delhi – 110 001Mob: +91 8130808686A soft copy should also be emailed to parisha.singh@ficci.com, krishan.kumar@ficci.com, krishan.bhardwaj@ficci.com and aioe@ficci.com.

events.title: Chhath Puja on the Yamuna 2026
events.description: Chhath 2026 in Delhi is Friday 13 to Monday 16 November. Nahay Khay 13 November, Kharna 14 November, Sandhya Arghya Sunday 15 November at about 5:28 pm (Delhi sunset), Usha Arghya Monday 16 November at about 6:44 am. The Irrigation and Flood Control Department tender for 2026 covers the Yamuna right bank from Nigam Bodh Ghat to Tanga Stand Store, ghats 1 to 32. Colony ghats are notified closer to the date. Free civic festival. No ticket. Follow the Delhi government notice on immersion and river entry; do not copy a Patna timetable.

events.title: Patiala Mehfil
events.description: Some evenings are not just about music, but about the feeling it leaves you with. Patiala Mehfil brings you an evening steeped in the soulful sounds of Punjabi folk, Sufi melodies and music that speaks straight to the heart. Rooted in the warmth of a traditional mehfil, this is an experience where music takes centre stage and every song brings its own emotion, story and charm.Expect melodies that make you pause, familiar tunes that get you singing along and moments that make you forget everything else for a while. Whether you come for the love of Punjabi music, the depth of Sufi sounds or simply a much-needed evening of sukoon, Patiala Mehfil invites you to settle in, sing along and lose yourself in the music
